name: code-evolve
description: Set up, run and check a self-evolving codebase from inside your agent: evolve-setup, evolve-run and evolve-status.

interface.longDescription: Turn a project into a self-evolving codebase. evolve-setup installs code-evolve and drafts the vision and spec with you; evolve-run drives one build-verify-commit cycle from your session; evolve-status reports progress, open requirements and anything that needs attention. Cycles run local shell scripts and git in your repository.
defaultPrompt: Set up code-evolve in this project
